svg.title: PRP — Distribution
svg.desc: Deliver across networks, across a group and across periods of disconnection.
svg.text: Deliver across networks, across a group and across periods of disconnection.
S: sender · A/B/C: aggregators · L: authorized listeners. Branches replicate the encrypted unit.
Unicast reaches one receiver; multicast carries one logical transmission to many listeners.
Neighbor cooperation transfers duplicate delivery sessions to the downstream fanout.
Example: an application associates three autonomous multicasts with one group.
Active senders receive one another’s transmissions; L represents passive listeners.
Group membership, writer authority and application rights are distinct; the group can outlive its sessions.
DTN — retain now, forward during an agreed window
Availability windows can be short, spaced or recurring, subject to the carrier and negotiated policy.
Custody acceptance is separate from recipient delivery; retention and expiry remain bounded.
Multicast custody identifies the branches or delivery set covered by each commitment.
RCP provides the extension framework; custody and DTN windows require their own section contracts.
